description: This file defines a PHP trait 'NormalizerTrait' used in serialization within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for normalizing objects and arrays of objects, ensuring they implement the necessary interfaces, and initializes model instances for serialization.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the model being normalized.

methods.name: setModelClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the model to be normalized.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the data to be normalized, either an array or object.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data to be normalized.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes a single object by converting it to an array, ensuring the model class implements the necessary interface.

methods.name: normalizeObjectsArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of objects, converting each to an array, with validation.

methods.name: checkForValidModelClass
methods.description: Validates that the model class implements the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: getInitializedModelInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a model instance initialized with the provided data, using constructor arguments if applicable.
